dataList.content:
Why are you so eager to leave me? Where are you trying to go?
你那么拼命地离开我，是想到哪儿去？

... I don't know.
……我不知道。

Just how far do you think you'll get when you don't even know where you're going?
连那都不知道，你到底是打算去哪儿啊……

The world is as vast as an ocean, and we are as insignificant as two specks in that infinite blue. And we've tried everything we could to find even a single meaning in existence.
在这浩瀚无垠的世界里……为了寻找哪怕一丝细微的意义，我们已付出了无数的努力。

But we couldn't. Because nothing has any meaning and everything is superfluous.
可哪里都没有。因为所谓的意义，根本不存在于任何地方。

Are you about to tell me that you've found meaning in those people?
从那些人身上……你难道找到了什么意义吗？

They are simply... those who move forward.
他们不过是……不断向前迈进的人们。

Wading blindly through the unknowable dark, they burn everything they are on bygone memories, on others who are but passing bookmarks in their lives, on meaning that will soon change... down to the last inch of their wicks.
他们会在甚至对自己前方的事物一无所知的情况下，为正在逝去的记忆，为经过身边的他人，为即将改变的意义，去殷切地赌上一切，将自身消耗殆尽。

None of them are heroes who can change the world. They are simply... beings who were thrown into this world, lost and confused... just like I am.
他们……无法成为英雄。和无法改变世界的我一样，都是……被扔进这世界的人。

So... I don't understand them. I never managed to.
因此我才……无法理解，哪怕此刻也一样。

I still don't understand why they hang onto those unfulfilling values that only project illusions of meaning.
执着于那些只是假装有其意义，却无法实现其真正意义的价值……我无法理解这样的他们……
... And you still want to go back outside with them? ……就算这样，你也还是想和那些人一起到外面去吗？

Meursault turns his gaze toward us, his eyes still full of uncertainty and doubt, and replies.
默尔索用无法理解的眼神凝视着我们，随后对让娜回答道。

Hahahaha!
哈哈哈！
Have you forgotten that I'm a Giant? Ah, who am I kidding? You don't forget. You were probably just swept up in the moment. 你啊，好像忘了我是巨人啦。不对，从不遗忘的你肯定不会忘掉这件事。只是突然被席卷了而已。

... You're lying to yourself, ma puce.
……那是欺瞒呀，小可爱。

You won't find understanding from those people. They'll just gaze and gaze at you—and you'll never understand them.
你只会被那些人凝视，而绝不会被理解。也无法去理解他们。

Don't you understand? Hell is those people—the Hell of nails that pin you down!
因为那些人不过是把你死死钉住的地狱啊！
